scopedCoverageNotes.text: Bexar County local candidate coverage:67 complete printed office fields and106 named choices from the current official generic sample ballot. Includes21 countywide offices,15 district judges,1 regional appellate chief,5 county commissioner/justice precinct contests,3 appraisal director places,14 municipal seats,6 school trustee contests, MUD1 permanent directors and Edwards Aquifer director district1.

The36 already-held county/district-judge contest identities and all45 corresponding candidacy identities are preserved;31 local races and61 choices were missing. Federal, statewide and legislative data and existing measure texts/explainers remain outside this focused installation. Local bond/tax/charter propositions remain open candidate-independent coverage work and their complete original samples are retained.

Numbered at-large city and Edgewood school places use their whole exact government electorate. Somerset single-member districts, commissioner precincts, justice precincts, MUD1, appraisal, aquifer and regional judicial territory retain precise separate division keys. Exact unmatched reader memberships remain listed in the installation manifest; no electoral district is widened to Bexar County.

Blank write-in lines are not people. Separately named declared write-in certification remains acquisition work. This packet establishes all named candidate office blocks printed in the two linked current generic sample documents; individualized address-specific sample parity and exact district reader memberships remain open.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Complete official Bexar County November3,2026 four-page generic Joint General, Special, Charter and Bond sample ballot; nativePDF bytes retained unchanged. All67 local named candidate office blocks read in full from all3 columns of every page, including all106 choices, printed party abbreviations, unopposed people and five-seat MUD director field. Each office candidate block independently replayed against saved native column text and visually checked on original full-page renders. Federal/statewide/legislative contests and statewide15thCourt of Appeals excluded. Generic blank write-in slots are not people. Exact city/school/special/precinct/court territories retained; no district fallback to county. All printed names, accents and party abbreviations are preserved exactly; no candidate addresses appear in reader quotes.
